title: Great experience with...
text: Great experience with CDT! There are lockers on site to store your things for 1 Euro, and the launch dock is right across the street. Super easy, and fun!
author: Karen_G

title: Sports club Arjona 👏👏👏
text:
I recommend 100% this Guadalquivir Kayaking experience. We received excellent treatment and it was great fun. 
We were with children and had a great time and the monitor Manuel was very attentive.
author: You_azzue

title: Relaxing trip on river
text: All very easy and a lovely relaxed trip up and down part of the river.  A good breeze stopped it from being hot but enthusiastic paddling made it a little wet so dress accordingly.
author: Tanya_B

title: Great Experience
text: Super fun experience kayaking along the river at your own pace. Absolute bargain for two hours! Highly recommend.
author: Amelia_S

title: Excellent break from the...
text: Excellent break from the heat ,The staff were helpful and laid back.It was far better than a river cruise as you decide where you go and at what pace the bridges came in as handy shelters from the sun ,and nicely added breaks to the journey.
author: Mike_T

title: The river walk is...
text: The walk along the river is a beautiful and alternative experience to see Seville from nostrils point of view. Although it is true that two hours may seem like a long time, we, with stops in the shade under the bridges, arrived well in time.
author: CarlosJavier_C

title: Staying Cool in Sevilla
text: Great experience! So fun to see the city from the water. Plus, it is cooler on the river than it is wandering around the city. I would advise bringing a water bottle. Would recommend this activity to anyone!
author: Ashleigh_W
